report.target: Next full UTC day after snapshot cutoff, close > open; flat is not up

random_80_20_diagnostic.status: Exact sample split reproduced on historical training subset only; NOT a valid forecasting headline because shared dates/outcomes can leak.

later_time.method: 1000 paired circular seven-observed-date block resamples; coins kept together

unseen_coin_market.method: 1000 paired circular seven-observed-date block resamples; coins kept together

report.test_reuse: Exploratory: this archive and final dates have been examined before. Not independent confirmation.
adaptations: Actual market outcomes replace invented labels; no 40-case quota.
Primary earlier/later calendar split with purge replaces random-row forecasting claims.
Unseen coins and later times test the sample geographic/time-shift analogue.
Class weights may improve UP recall but can harm precision or accuracy. A balanced model is not assumed better.
Character trial is reported; word Model 2 is predeclared for understandable explanations, not chosen because it wins test accuracy.
Each coin/target-day has total weight one across its snapshots.
Sentiment means estimated language in this archive sample, not full X sentiment or causal impact.
